item.title: Award-winning Police Dog Reno retires from the force
item.description: A courageous police dog who took on multiple armed criminals during his crime-fighting career has worked his last shift in service of the public. PD Reno, a seven-year-old German Shepherd, joined the force on 5 December 2019 after being recruited from a breeder in Poland.
